note: Vacancies come from partner organisations' HR departments. Add each to items. Fields: id, partner (organisation name), title{en,fr}, type{en,fr}, location{en,fr}, level (CEFR level expected, e.g. B2), deadline (YYYY-MM-DD, optional), desc{en,fr}, applyUrl (optional: the employer's own application page; if empty, candidates apply through Windsor on WhatsApp). Leave items empty when there are no open roles.
